target: 03 Requirements and specifications/PRD/Recovery Workbench PRD P4 rwb-access v1.md

fixes.old: Fourteen areas, fixed by the list of values, not by code.
fixes.new:
Fourteen areas, fixed by the list of values, not by code.

A role's owner is the holder of the A letter in the Platform administration capability area for that role; for reference-data roles the owner is RW-COE. A caller holding only the R letter owns no role and is refused.

fixes.old: Where a value is open under a decision, it is named.
fixes.new: Where a value is open under a decision, it is named. The programme NFR targets apply to every service. Interface-level volume and window targets are open under DL11 and use placeholder R9 until DL11 confirms them.

fixes.old: Events carry IDs and facts only (Architecture v5 slide 42 notes).
fixes.new:
Events carry IDs and facts only (Architecture v5 slide 42 notes).
- Each access row records the version the owning service applied at the event; rwb-decision keeps the registry that is the source of each version and its effective date.

disposition.note: Ownership rule added to section 3.3 (A letter in Platform administration; RW-COE for reference data; R-only caller refused). Access model not edited here.
Section 7 now inherits programme NFR targets and states interface-level volume and window targets as open under DL11 with placeholder R9.
Section 8.1 now states the access row records the owning service's applied version, with rwb-decision's registry as source of version and effective date.
Correction feed and CAP-P5-010, FR-P5-017/018 belong to PRD P5 rwb-document v2 and FSD P5 v3; this P4 PRD has no P5 references to change.
